leadText: (Japanese: クイン子 Queenko) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.
plainText:
(Japanese: クイン子 Queenko) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Queenko first appeared in A Performance Pop Quiz!, where she competed in the Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase. For the first round she was placed in a group with two other performers, with the theme of the round being a Pokémon quiz. She and her won the round and proceeded to the Freestyle Performance, where she subsequently lost to with her and .

Queenko reappeared in Master Class Is in Session!, where she competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase. She was either eliminated in the first round or the second round.

==Pokémon==
 

==Showcases==
===Princess Keys obtained===
This listing is of the s Queenko has obtained:
At least three Princess Keys (prior to Master Class Is in Session!)

===Master Class ranking===
Queenko has achieved the following ranking in the Master Class tournament:
Showcase - Top 10 / Top 28 (Master Class Is in Session!)

===Other achievements===
Queenko has competed in the following Rookie Class tournaments:
Showcase - Freestyle Performance (A Performance Pop Quiz!)
 

==Trivia==
In closed captions for the English dub of A Performance Pop Quiz!, she is referred to as orange hair girl.
